<h2>Version v1.8.0 - 8/30/2025</h2>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>What's Changed</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 1.2rem;">&nbsp;</span></p>
<h4><strong>Bug Fixes</strong></h4>
<p>- Added missing spell description for Absorb Crystal. Fixes #263</p>
<p>- Fix Glyph of Illumination n no longer causes doors/buttons/etc to fall to ground when going through block. Fixes #269</p>
<p>- Updated the incorrect description of the Harvest spell. Fixes #190</p>
<p>- Summon Quicksand can be cast using dispensers</p>
<p>- Limit pocket dimension size. Fixes #273</p>
<p>- Lowered skeleton mage spawnratet</p>
<p>- Temporal Anchor is now Baubles belt slot</p>
<p>- Prevent infinite loops with Spell teleporter when y is less than 0. (#266)</p>
<p>- Add message for already bound Diamond Goose and improve detection range logic</p>
<p>- Fixed critical bug causing skeleton mages to never despawn, eating up all spawn caps eventually</p>
<p>- Fixed some wizard entity AI crashes</p>
<p>- Soulbound Wands are now returned if the player self-resurrects. Fixes #277</p>
<p>- Arcane Barrier color alterations are permanent and synchronized on servers</p>
<p>- Arcane Barrier color alterations are permanent and synchronized on servers</p>

<h4><strong>Features</strong></h4>
<p>- Skull sentinels now notify the caster about the detected entity's name and position periodically.</p>
<p>- Renamed Chaos Gem Ring (-> Chaos Piercer)</p>
<p>- New artefacts: Circlet of Circling, Rainbow String</p>
<p>- Added more spells, mostly for Fire element</p>
<p>- Added more new artefacts</p>
<p>- Added more new artefacts</p>
<p>- (Mass) Pyrokinesis lits TNT blocks</p>
<p>- Fix situational crash with Curse of Umbra</p>
<p>- More new artefacts</p>
<p>- Added "metamagic" Spell type, changed existing metamagic spells' type</p>
<p>- Added Ancient Wand</p>
<p>- Added Circlet of the Unknown</p>
<p>- Golden Scroll Holder can accept additional items (if configured in the configs). These have no effect.</p>
<p>- Russian handbook translation and updated mod translation by K-LAgama</p>
